Check the event page here https://store.steampowered.com/sale/OneGamerFund

The charities are: Global Game Jam, IGDA Foundation, Take This, Chid's Play, The AbleGamers Charity, Games For Change and Stack Up.

notes.title: New update released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're pleased to announce that we have released a new update with more content and fixes for Nanuleu.

Here's the list of new features

[list]
[*] New maps: Exploration and Remnants 
[*] Localization to French (Thanks to our friend Antoine) 
[*] More achievements and leader boards
[*] 2x speed button.
[*] Tree counter included in resource bar
[*] Time is shown in the game screen
[*] Adjusted number of enemy war trees and max units per tree
[*] Little adjustments in UI elements
[/list]

We're sorry this update took so long but it had been difficult for us to wok on our games as a full time job and we've been doing other jobs and projects.  But as we said, we're happy to have this update ready and we hope you like the new content and features. Also thank you very much to our friends, beta testers, our local community GameDevGT and everyone that suggested some of these features to us. 

We're eager to see what you think about the new update, please leave your comments in the forums :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26535910/a5ad77a2eeeb72d7bacd22f406796fe77ba583c8.png[/img]

notes.title: Earth Day Sale
notes.notes:
To celebrate Earth Day Nanuleu will be on sale, you can get it at 34% off. During this weekend, 5% of the earnings will be donated to a local NGO, Foundation Defensores de la Naturaleza (FDN), in charge of protecting and managing four conservation areas in our country, Guatemala.

We invite you to join local Earth Day celebrations where you live and maybe plant trees in real life. 

Happy Earth Day 🙂

notes.title: Game Update & Thanks For Your Support And Feedback
notes.notes:
Hello!  

Thanks to everyone that has played our game.  We're really happy for the launch and for all the people that have been supporting us. 

Based on feedback received from some of our players we've decided to make First Encounter, Warrior (first level after the tutorial) more friendly to new users.  

The level will have fewer enemy spawn locations. We hope this change will smooth the learning curve of the game in general and make the next levels accessible to more players. 

Sage levels of the game present subtle tweaks that we hope will make achievements more attainable, while maintaining the difficulty level as it was. 

We hope this change will make the game more enjoyable to everyone, new and experienced players alike.

We're thankful for your reviews and suggestions. If you need support for the game please feel free to contact us through Steam Community Forums.
